# Candidate application sentences (MIT Solve 2027)

<!-- Generated by research/solve2027-impact/compute.py from NUMBERS.json; do not edit by hand. -->

Each sentence and its caution are rendered from [`NUMBERS.json`](NUMBERS.json); the keys they rely on follow. Every number is model-relative: it describes what the Route-Check API concluded for fire-scenario members of forecasts produced retrospectively for the March 2025 fires, not what happened to residents, and never an evacuation outcome or casualties avoided. Departures that the 1-hour scenario window rules out whatever the fire ("window-limited") are never counted as fire effects. Say "checked route (within the model)", never "safe route". Definitions and caveats: [README.md](README.md).

## S1

> Using forecasts our model produced retrospectively for the recorded fire conditions of the March 2025 Uiseong-Andong and Yeongdeok wildfires, our planner checked vehicle departures from 174 OpenStreetMap-mapped villages and care facilities, each to one of its three nearest OSM-mapped schools or community halls (not official shelters), against 4 fire scenarios from the forecast at six departure times 10 minutes apart after each of three forecast times per region, in 9,396 recorded route checks (one per place, forecast time, candidate destination and departure time).

NUMBERS.json keys: `places@all/places`, `attempts@all/pooled`, `destinations_used.school@all/places`, `destinations_used.community_hall@all/places`, `records.route_checks@all/pooled`, `records.dispatch_attempts@all/pooled`, `records.rechecks@all/pooled`, `records.research_route_checks@all/pooled`, `osm_origins_not_checkable@all/places`, `cases@all/pooled`, `destinations_used.shelter@all/places`

Caution: Route checks are model computations by the Route-Check API recorded on the evaluated macOS host, not field trials or drills. The forecasts were produced in 2026 from recorded 2025 inputs (release research-final-20261015), not issued during the fires; the 4 fire scenarios are scenario members drawn independently per cell from the forecast, not simulations of the actual fire. Destinations: 68 OSM schools and 115 OSM community halls; for one Yeongdeok place one of its three candidates is an unnamed OSM point tagged amenity=shelter without shelter_type. None is an official evacuation shelter. The cache holds 9,722 route-check records in all: the 9,396 above, 279 re-checks of timed-out checks (shown in place of the original, as in the planner) and 47 checks of recorded research missions. 3 further OSM villages had no road node within 2 km and were never checked.

## S2

> In the recorded Uiseong-Andong scenarios, among place-and-forecast-time cases whose fastest fire-free trip to one of the place's three nearest OSM-mapped schools or community halls (not official shelters) still fits the 1-hour scenario window, 13 of 252 (5.2%) had no checked route (within the model) for departure at the forecast time and 23 of 246 (9.3%) for departure 30 minutes later (Yeongdeok: 8 of 270, 3.0%, at both).

NUMBERS.json keys: `not_checked_although_fits.offset_0000s@uiseong_andong_2025/pooled`, `not_checked_although_fits.offset_1800s@uiseong_andong_2025/pooled`, `not_checked_although_fits.offset_0000s@yeongdeok_2025/pooled`, `window_limited.offset_0000s@uiseong_andong_2025/pooled`, `window_limited.offset_1800s@uiseong_andong_2025/pooled`, `window_limited_among_not_checked.offset_3000s@uiseong_andong_2025/pooled`, `not_checked_although_fits.offset_2400s@uiseong_andong_2025/pooled`, `not_checked_although_fits.offset_3000s@uiseong_andong_2025/pooled`, `places@uiseong_andong_2025/places`, `not_checked_although_fits.offset_1800s@yeongdeok_2025/pooled`

Caution: Window-corrected: a departure can only be checked if the fastest fire-free trip plus the required 120 s stay ends within the 1-hour scenario window. Departures where even that does not fit ("window-limited": in Uiseong-Andong 0 at the forecast time and 6 at +30 minutes) are left out, because no route could be checked there whatever the fire. Without this correction the decline toward +50 minutes is mostly the window: at +50 minutes only trips of up to 8 minutes fit, and 141 of the 149 Uiseong-Andong cases without a checked route then were window-limited. The corrected share at +40 and +50 minutes is 9.3% and 7.2% in Uiseong-Andong. "No checked route" = model_no_route or unresolved; it is not a prediction that residents could not escape. Cases count each place once per forecast time (84 places x 3).

## S3

> In 21 of 522 place-and-forecast-time cases (4.0%), the model found no checked route from the place to any of its three nearest OSM-mapped schools or community halls (not official shelters) at any of the six departure times: 11 had no route within the model and 10 were unresolved, which the planner never presents as safe.

NUMBERS.json keys: `no_checked_route_any_offset@all/pooled`, `best_verdict.model_no_route@all/pooled`, `best_verdict.unresolved@all/pooled`, `no_checked_route_any_offset.trip_fits_at_offset_0000s@all/pooled`, `attempts.unresolved.AT_ISSUE_FAILURE@all/pooled`, `attempts.unresolved.TIMEOUT@all/pooled`, `places.no_checked_route_any_offset_any_input@all/places`, `no_checked_route_at_offset_0000s@all/pooled`, `deadline.none_model_no_route@all/pooled`, `deadline.none_unresolved@all/pooled`

Caution: The window does not explain these cases: for all 21 of them the fastest fire-free trip fits the 1-hour scenario window for departure at the forecast time. "No route within the model" (model_no_route) is a statement about this model and input scope, not proof that escape is impossible. "Unresolved" means the system could not judge and must never be read as safe or as no-route; of all 9,396 displayed attempts, 186 were unresolved with API reason code AT_ISSUE_FAILURE ("limits already exceeded at departure") and 6 with TIMEOUT. These cases involve 21 distinct places; they are also exactly the 21 cases without a checked route for immediate departure.

## S4

> Counting each place once, 30 of the 174 OSM-mapped villages and care facilities (17.2%) had, for at least one of the three forecast times, a departure time without a checked route (within the model) to any of their three nearest OSM-mapped schools or community halls (not official shelters) although the fastest fire-free trip would still fit the 1-hour scenario window.

NUMBERS.json keys: `places.not_checked_although_fits_any_offset_any_input@all/places`, `places.no_checked_route_any_offset_any_input@all/places`, `places.not_checked_although_fits_at_offset_3000s_any_input@all/places`, `places.not_checked_although_fits_any_offset_any_input@uiseong_andong_2025/places`, `places.not_checked_although_fits_any_offset_any_input@yeongdeok_2025/places`

Caution: Model-relative and tied to the recorded scenarios, the 10-minute departure grid and the 1-hour scenario window. Of these places, 21 had no checked route at any departure time for some forecast time. Window-limited departures are not counted: of the 65 places with an unchecked departure at +50 minutes, only 14 had a fire-free trip that fits; the others are more than 8 minutes from every candidate destination. A place outside this count is not "safe".

## S5

> At each place's leave-by time, the travel-time-only route to the same destination (one of the place's three nearest OSM-mapped schools or community halls, not official shelters) met predicted flames in at least one of 4 fire scenarios in 9 of the 147 comparisons whose leave-by time was earlier than 50 minutes after the forecast time (6.1%), all in Uiseong-Andong, and in none of the 354 at +50 minutes; where it did, the checked alternative took 0.5 to 21.8 minutes longer (median 5.5 minutes) and was 0.3 to 12.8 km longer.

NUMBERS.json keys: `travel_only.fastest_meets_flames@all/pooled#leave_by_before_3000s`, `travel_only.fastest_meets_flames@all/pooled#leave_by_3000s`, `travel_only.extra_arrival_s.min@all/pooled`, `travel_only.extra_arrival_s.max@all/pooled`, `travel_only.extra_arrival_s.median@all/pooled`, `travel_only.extra_length_m.min@all/pooled`, `travel_only.extra_length_m.max@all/pooled`, `travel_only.fastest_meets_flames@all/pooled`, `travel_only.clear_pairs_equal_arrival@all/pooled`, `destinations_used.school@all/places`, `destinations_used.community_hall@all/places`, `travel_only.fastest_meets_flames@yeongdeok_2025/pooled`

Caution: Only 9 of 501 comparisons in all; do not generalise. The comparison exists only at each place's latest checked departure and toward its default checked destination; at +50 minutes only destinations within 8 minutes fit the 1-hour window, so those comparisons are short trips. "Predicted flames" = centre-model flame contact in at least one scenario member, not an observed fire. In the other 492 comparisons the fastest route had no predicted flame contact and arrived at the same second as the checked route (492 of 492). Destinations: 68 OSM schools and 115 OSM community halls; for one Yeongdeok place one of its three candidates is an unnamed OSM point tagged amenity=shelter without shelter_type. None is an official evacuation shelter. Never describe the checked route as "safe".

## S6

> On the road graph used for routing, for 115 of the 174 OSM-mapped villages and care facilities (66.1%), all routes starting from the place's mapped road entry point toward its three nearest OSM-mapped schools or community halls (not official shelters) pass through at least one common road segment, a single point of failure in the model's road network; measured along the shortest route, the last segment that all routes share ends a median of 674 m from the entry point, and within 100 m for only 10 of the 115.

NUMBERS.json keys: `redundancy.turn_aware_paths_1@all/places`, `redundancy.shared_stretch_m.median@all/places`, `redundancy.shared_stretch_within_100m@all/places`, `redundancy.turn_aware_equals_plain@all/places`, `redundancy.single_cut_at_entry_node@all/places`, `destinations_used.school@all/places`, `destinations_used.community_hall@all/places`, `redundancy.entry_out_degree_1@all/places`, `redundancy.shared_stretch_m.min@all/places`, `redundancy.shared_stretch_m.max@all/places`

Caution: A property of the provisional pre-fire OSM road graph (2025-03-21 snapshot; missing one-way tags assumed two-way) and of the planner's entry point (nearest node of the routable road network to the OSM point), not a field-verified count of access roads. "Pass through at least one common road segment" = the largest set of routes that pairwise share no directed road segment has one route (unit-capacity max-flow = 1, computed with and without turn restrictions, equal for 174 of 174 places); it ignores road capacity, travel time and fire. For 108 of the 115 the first shared segment is the one leaving the entry point; lengths are sums of straight edge chords (EPSG:5179). Destinations: 68 OSM schools and 115 OSM community halls; for one Yeongdeok place one of its three candidates is an unnamed OSM point tagged amenity=shelter without shelter_type. None is an official evacuation shelter.

## S7

> Every leave-by time in this analysis can be recomputed from the recorded API results: applying the planner's rules to the original attempts recorded by the Route-Check API reproduces the API's own deadline fields for 522 of 522 place-and-forecast-time cases, all 8 displayed differences are explained by re-checks of timed-out checks, and an independent second implementation recomputes every reported number.

NUMBERS.json keys: `api_check.recorded_equals_planner_rule_on_original@all/pooled`, `api_check.displayed_differs_explained_by_recheck@all/pooled`, `api_check.displayed_equals_recorded.latest_checked_depart_offset_s@all/pooled`

Caution: Internal consistency of software and recorded data only. It does not validate the forecast, the hazard model, the road data or real-world safety. The planner displays re-checks, so its deadline equals the API's recorded latest_checked_depart_offset_s for 517 of 522 cases.
